limitations: The final acceptance case uses deterministic fakes only at model, provider, researcher, and resolver seams; earlier focused contract cases retain their documented injected component boundaries.
No case calls a real model, Jina, network, DNS, or .env file.
Measures invariant compliance, not factual-answer quality, benchmark superiority, model calibration, live latency, or live cost.
